notes: One-character play: the only scenario is solo. Start coins, rent, odd-job pay, wages and eviction rules per difficulty are in data/solo.json (funds_mult here is unused). goals[].check: {event,count,on_time?,events?} counts game events; {cond:[...]} = SysCond for any resident; {jobs:n} = n employed residents; {finished:[interaction ids]} = the pawn finished one of them; event checks may add reason (bill_paid payload reasons) or rung_in (moved_house rung). No rewards: done_line is said once and the pawn gets a small mood lift (buff small_step).

relaxed.label: Easy
relaxed.desc: 350 coins, a sofa bed in the flat, rent 55, bills 20% cheaper, needs fall 20% slower, wages 10% better. Good for learning.

normal.label: Normal
normal.desc: 200 coins, an empty flat, rent 70 (half the first week paid, the rest due on Sunday). Hardly any money; you can just get by if you work from the first days.

hard.label: Hard
hard.desc: 100 coins, rent 85 with the first rent due on day 7, bills 30% dearer, needs fall 20% faster, wages 10% lower. One missed rent starts the eviction.

scenarios.label: Solo Start
scenarios.blurb: One Folk, a rented studio, 200 coins and nobody to feed you. Find work, pay the rent, climb out of the bare room.
scenarios.moved_in: You've just moved in with a bag and an old phone. Click %s to get started.

tips_no_computer.1: Nobody feeds you. Food costs coins and cooking costs ingredients. Your first goal is a job: click Phone at the top and open the Jobs app, or click the mailbox for Odd Jobs.

tips: This is you. You choose everything your Folk does: if you give no orders they stand and wait while hunger and tiredness build. Click things in the world to choose what they do.

Nobody feeds you. Food costs coins (the bakery, Zip Burger, a vending machine) and cooking costs ingredients. Your first goal is a job: click Phone at the top and open the Jobs app, or click the mailbox for Odd Jobs.
Rent and bills come every week; miss the rent and you can lose the flat. Click Myself (next to your face) for things you can do with no furniture, like sleeping on the floor.
Space pauses. Keys 1, 2 and 3 set the speed. Press B to buy furniture, M for the map, F1 for all controls.

goals.label: Eat a meal you paid for
goals.hint: Food costs coins: a vending machine, the bakery or Zip Burger, or groceries for a stove.
goals.done_line: A real meal, paid for with your own coins.

goals.label: A night in a real bed
goals.hint: Buy a bed (B) or find a place that has one.
goals.done_line: A proper bed. You slept like a log.

goals.label: Your first wage
goals.hint: Find work: the Jobs app on the phone, a Help wanted card in a shop window, or the job centre at city hall.
goals.done_line: Your first wage is in your pocket.

goals.label: Pay your first rent
goals.hint: The rent pays itself when the coins are there on the day it is due.
goals.done_line: Rent paid. The roof is yours for another week.

goals.label: Make a friend
goals.hint: Talk to the same person a few times: a neighbour, someone at work, the regulars at the cafe.
goals.done_line: Somebody in this town is glad to see you.

goals.label: Move up out of the studio
goals.hint: A better flat needs a steady income and the deposit (Household, Home).
goals.done_line: A better place. You've come a long way from the bare room.
